overview: The Women Entrepreneurship Platform (WEP) by NITI Aayog is a unified access portal that aggregates government schemes, mentorship, incubators, accelerators, and financial resources to support women entrepreneurs across India. It serves as a one-stop information hub connecting women-led ventures with over 300+ resources, 944+ mentors, 835+ government initiatives, and 576+ incubators & accelerators. WEP enables registration, profile completion, mentorship matching, and access to curated schemes and partner networks to foster entrepreneurial growth.
objectives: Provide a unified platform for women entrepreneurs to access government schemes and resources
Connect women entrepreneurs with mentors, incubators, accelerators, and industry experts
Facilitate access to financial resources, grants, and schemes tailored for women-led businesses
Enable networking and peer support through the WEP community
Offer personalized guidance via Smart Match mentorship programs
Support skill development through workshops, videos, and knowledge resources
Promote financial inclusion and growth opportunities for women entrepreneurs
Showcase and recognize achievements of women entrepreneurs through awards and outreach
eligibility: Women entrepreneurs in India seeking to start, grow, or scale their ventures can register on the platform. No specific eligibility criteria are mentioned for platform access; registration requires OTP verification and profile completion to access full resources.
benefits: Access to over 300+ resources including government schemes, mentorship from 944+ experts, 835+ government initiatives, 576+ incubators & accelerators, networking with 112,832+ WEP family members, personalized partner recommendations via Smart Match, mentorship guidance, financial inclusion support, skill development through articles and videos, workshop participation, and recognition through WEP awards and outreach programs.
financial_support: WEP does not directly provide financial support but facilitates access to financial resources, grants, and schemes tailored for women-led businesses through its 'Access to Finance' section, which curates funding opportunities from government initiatives, financial institutions, and partner organizations.
application_process: 1. Visit the WEP portal at wep.gov.in 2. Click 'Register' or 'Start your entrepreneurial journey' 3. Enter OTP for verification 4. Complete registration and set a new password 5. Complete your profile after registration 6. Use Smart Match to get personalized partner recommendations 7. Explore mentors, government initiatives, incubators, accelerators, and schemes 8. Access financial resources via the 'Access to Finance' section 9. Join workshops, view articles and videos for skill development 10. Engage with the WEP community and partners for networking and support
caveats: Only 2 free pre-registration resources are available before requiring full registration
Some resources and services may have validity periods or expiry dates (e.g., discounts, offers)
Access to certain partner offers and discounts may require active WEP membership
The platform aggregates third-party schemes; eligibility and terms are governed by the respective implementing agencies
